subject: Air pooling, hotel block adjustments & shift sprint for MountainView Roadshow
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MountainView: early headcount gap + pool flights idea

Team —

Quick heads-up: CloudSphere confirmed they’ll be onsite and asked if we can support a product deep-dive at 2pm on Day 1. That adds two additional headcount-hours during the prime demo window. We currently have three scheduled booth leads for that slot.

Options I can see:
- Pull Tessa for a 2-hour overlap (she’s on standby)
- Pool travel for two late-arriving contributors (save one hotel night per person) and route them on the morning flight arriving 11:30am so they can swap into the 2pm slot

I attached a quick sheet with pooling candidates — please review the feasibility column.

Ask: Priyom, can you run the flight pooling feasibility with Ops? Marissa, can you confirm whether CloudSphere needs private meeting space (their rep Elise cc’d below)? If pooling doesn’t work we’ll need a local backfill.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Field Events Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: flight-pooling-ronald-crew.xlsx
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MountainView: early headcount gap + pool flights idea

Priya —

Quick check after a call with Ops: airline holds are limited for the 11:30am flight but we can request standby/pooling for up to two people if they agree to flexible tickets. I pinged Airline Ops (support@airlinecorp.com) for a same-day change fee waiver request under our corporate account; they said it’s a "case-by-case".

Notes from Ops:
- Pooling reduces one hotel night for each pooled traveler if they share a room; we should verify rooming preferences (single vs shared).
- Need written approval from Partner (CloudSphere) for any last-minute on-site additions to the private deep-dive room. Elise is cc’d.

I’ll keep the hold for 48 hours. If we can’t get the waiver I recommend we pull Tessa for the 2pm and move the pooled flights into the following day.

–Priyom

Hi Priya — thanks for the flag. We can accommodate two additional Redwood contributors in the product deep-dive; please confirm they’re introduced at the start and provided 10 minutes each to present. We don’t require a private room but would like a quiet corner for the first hour.

If you pool travelers into shared rooms that’s fine — our budget team prefers minimizing unnecessary nights. Elise
CloudSphere — Partnerships
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MountainView: early headcount gap + pool flights idea

All —

Updated rooming and staffing plan attached (hotel-block-hilton-mv-rooms.pdf). I confirmed with Hilton Sales; the block has 4 king rooms and 6 doubles. We can convert two kings to doubles if needed, but there’s a 24-hour cutoff for changes.

I also flagged Tessa as the primary backup for the Day 1 demo block; she’s confirmed availability for a 2-hour overlap. If Ops can get the waiver, we’ll still proceed with pooling as it saves $320 total and reduces shuttle runs.

Tessa — can you confirm if you’re OK with a 10:30am pickup from the Hilton to the venue if we go pooling route?

Attachment: hotel-block-hilton-mv-rooms.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MountainView: early headcount gap + pool flights idea

Confirmed — happy to cover the 2pm slot and take the 10:30am pickup. Also updated the shift sprint CSV with my overlap window (shift-sprint-3_15-3_18.csv).

Logistics recap (for the runbook we’ll hand to Ops):
- Pooling: requested waiver with Airline Ops; if approved, two pooled travelers booked on 11:30am flight, room-share for one night.
- Backup: Tessa overlap 1.5–3pm Day 1.
- Hotel: move two kings to doubles only if waiver confirmed (cutoff: 24 hours before check-in).
- Drive: shuttle pickup scheduled at 10:30am from Hilton to venue; point person: Marissa.

I’ll upload the final runbook to the Drive folder and notify security for badge pre-clear.

Thanks — Tessa

Attachment: shift-sprint-3_15-3_18.csv
